parameters.name: ChildInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the network instance to query.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceRegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the network instance.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to obtain region IDs.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceRouteTableId
parameters.description: The route table ID of the network instance to query.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

- **VPC**: virtual private cloud.

- **VBR**: virtual border router.

- **CCN**: Cloud Connect Network.

parameters.name: DestinationCidrBlock
parameters.description: The destination CIDR block of the conflicting route entry.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page during paging. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **1** to **50**.
